svg.title: Stock and audit commit together; JSON reads the same rows
svg.desc: An HTTP adjustment enters StockService. JPA updates the versioned inventory row, JdbcClient inserts its audit record, and the transaction commits or rolls back both. The duality view reads the same stock row. HTTP traces, logs and pool metrics go to Grafana LGTM.
svg.text: A shared quantity powers every feature
HTTP traces + logs + pool metrics → Grafana LGTM
svg.metadata: Source artwork: social-icon-builder bundled feature-icons (jpa.svg, duality-views.svg, observability.svg). All artwork is inlined or embedded; no external assets.
